description: This is an evidence-backed starting map for a future Goodreads CLI.

novel_features.name: Goodreads authenticated web route atlas
novel_features.description: Expose an evidence-backed Goodreads route map covering shelves, books, reviews, messages, notes, quotes, friends, genres, recommendations, notifications, and public sitemap-derived hubs despite the absence of a current public Goodreads API.

novel_features.name: Compact Goodreads MCP search and execute surface
novel_features.description: Default MCP registration uses goodreads_search plus goodreads_execute for route discovery and dispatch instead of flooding agents with dozens of raw endpoint mirrors.

novel_features.name: Approval-gated notes and shelf mutation support
novel_features.description: Model real Goodreads account actions such as Kindle note publicizing, shelf edits, message marks, and review updates with dry-run previews and the GOODREADS_PP_ALLOW_WRITES=1 gate before PP-side live writes.
